name: eso-antiquities-scrying-puzzle-solver
description: A local photo recognizer and exact budgeted solver for ESO Antiquities Scrying puzzles.

scripts.dev: npm run prepare:runtime && node scripts/build-worker.mjs && vite --host 0.0.0.0
scripts.build: npm run prepare:runtime && node scripts/build-worker.mjs && vite build && node scripts/build-offline.mjs
scripts.check: npm run prepare:runtime && npm test && npm run test:vision && npm run build && node --test test/built-worker.test.mjs
